content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Dr. YSRHU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Dr. Y.S.R. Horticultural University, College of Horticulture, Parvathipuram (Dr. YSRHU) for various supportive and technical positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under Dr. YSRHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for posts including Electrician, Record Assistant, Lab Boy, and Messenger.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Candidates are required to attend the interview directly at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 13 October 2026 at the Office of the Associate Dean, College of Horticulture, Parvathipuram.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Electrician position must possess an ITI certificate in the Electrical trade from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Record Assistant vacancies?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Record Assistant post must have successfully passed the SSC (Class 10) or an equivalent examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any language requirements for Lab Boy and Messenger posts?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates applying for Lab Boy and Messenger positions must be able to read and write in any one of the regional languages.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply for Dr. YSRHU jobs?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to participate in the walk-in interview as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You must bring a filled-in application form, original certificates along with self-attested photocopies of your educational qualifications, ID proof, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Are these positions permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These positions are purely on an outsourcing and contractual basis and do not confer any right for regular appointment in the university.
